page.layout: One page of text: running head at top with page number at top right; then a centred heading and motto; below, a framed woodcut (emblem picture, no text inside); below the picture, a verse of four lines with a large initial letter.

main_text.l: AEra graui cunctos veluti campani sonore,

l.i: Ipsa licet penitus sint sibi surda, cient:
Sic es recta docens alios, peruersa sequute,
Quisque aliis sapiens, non sapis ipse tibi.

page.notes: The initial A is a large woodcut letter joined to "Era". The woodcut frame holds no printed text. The heading "XXXXIIII." is printed as "XXXIIII." in the scan; the numeral reads XXXIIII. Verse lines are as printed; the ending "sequute" and "Quisque" are copied as printed. Stray marks in the lower part of the page are stains, not text.
